text:
Phase 5: compactor at summary/<NNN>.md + merge=ours discipline

Compactor write_summary already lands at summary/<NNN>.md (Phase 2/3
work). New here: registers merge.ours.driver at scaffold and adds a
rebase-time alignment step in rebase_and_merge so ARCH §2.6 holds
even for the only-theirs-add and unchanged-on-ours cases that vanilla
merge=ours silently ignores. tests/merge_ours.rs is the load-bearing
real-git integration test the ball requires. ARCH §2.6 rewritten;
README updated; coverage 100%.
